meta.about: Banknote exchange merchants: use a banknote on one to get the real items back for a fee per note (docs/note-exchange.md). Merchants, fees, members status, accepted items and their refusal lines are from the OSRS Wiki (each NPC's page and transcript). The menu, sound and closing item box are from rsprox captures of Virilis (recording 1104, rev 237). npc is the NpcIdentifiers name; gameval is the cache's own name for that id.
meta.accepts: Omitted: any banknote. "bury": items whose unnoted form has a Bury option. A list: those unnoted item names.
meta.lines: Defaults for every merchant; a merchant's own lines replace them. {fee} is the merchant's fee.

lines.notBanknote: I exchange banknotes for real items. That's not a banknote.
lines.noCoins: I charge {fee} coins for exchanging each banknote.
